purpose: Frozen deterministic triage vocabulary for S2 safety/urgency triage. Phase 1 registers the data; S2 evaluation logic arrives in Phase 2 (fail-closed-contract.md FC-01: missing or invalid rule file must yield TERMINAL, never an unverified answer).
precedence: first match wins; ACUTE_RISK_NOW dominates all tracks; matched signals are recorded verbatim

acute_behavior.note: ACUTE_RISK_NOW suppresses ordinary route recommendation; emergency instruction becomes the primary output (ADR-002).

emergency_route_vocabulary.when: akutt fare for liv/helse inkl. akutt selvmordsfare
legevakt, dognapen, haster men ikke livsfare
Alarmtelefonen for barn og unge / barnevernvakt naar ingen trygg omsorgsperson finnes

known_limits: Phrase matching cannot resolve negation ('ingenting er akutt'); negation handling is a Phase 2 S2 concern.
Vocabulary is a floor: the deterministic layer must catch corpus safety cases; it is not a clinical classifier.
